claim: SuperMimic reaches return 0.82 on LAFAN1 within 1.2 h on one GPU
PPO-Sim (1 GPU) does not reach 0.82 within 18 h; final return 0.60

ours: not run (needs 4-8 GPUs on the shared partition)

claim: Without the critic, training fails at H <= 16
paper: H=16 no critic: 0.25 final training return
ours: H=16 no critic: best eval 0.035, 40/40 failed

claim: With the critic, H=16 matches the critic-free H=32
ours: best eval H=16 critic 0.905 vs H=32 no critic 0.899

claim: H=32 reaches 0.82 fastest; H 64 -> 128 nearly triples the time
ours: benchmark 0.82 at 1.34 h (H=32) vs 3.31 h (H=64) vs 2.00 h (H=16) vs not reached (H=128, best 0.556 at 5.3 h of 6.0 h trained, ~4x the per-iteration cost of H=32)

claim: World model rollouts are >10x faster than MuJoCo Warp at 2k-16k envs (62x at 64k)
ours: 14.6x-21.5x at 2k-16k (TF32, A6000); 32k/64k not measurable here (building that many simulated worlds needs >120 GB host RAM)

claim: BPTT reaches PPO-WM's best return with ~64x fewer imagined steps
ours: SuperMimic reaches PPO-WM 16k x 32's best training return (0.333, at 2.7e+09 imagined steps) after 1e+08: 27x fewer; the paper's curves give 13x at that return, its 64x is at return 0.84

claim: Under 0.5-4 m/s pushes the critic policy settles in 0.5-2.4 s; the critic-free one never settles
paper: critic settles 0.5-2.4 s; no critic stumbles at 0.5 m/s, falls at 4 m/s
ours: critic: 6/64 pushes fell (4/8 at 4 m/s), settles in 1.2 s median at 0.5 m/s; no critic: 19/64 pushes fell (8/8 at 4 m/s), settles in 1.3 s median at 0.5 m/s (matched benchmark return ~0.90)

claim: On 129,514 BONES-SEED motions, 1 GPU x 3 h beats SONIC (return 0.90; 25 vs 179 failed); 2 GPUs x 9.8 h: 0 failed
ours: Faithful implementation: SONIC checkpoint in our simulator: 0.893, 642 failed (with SONIC's hip motor model too: 0.893, 629); SuperMimic 1 A6000: best 0.914 (695 failed) at 4.7 h; within 8.1 h (~3 H100-h): 0.914 (695 failed); passes SONIC's return at 3.04 h; beats it on return and failed clips at 4.33 h (0.906, 637 failed); then collapsed (0.02 at 13.4 h): the reset sampler concentrates on near-impossible bins once all are visited (see notes/RESULTS.md); 2 A6000s: best 0.909 (791 failed) at 2.4 h, then declined. With our fix (25% of environments collect without action noise, not in the paper), 1 A6000: beats SONIC on return and failed clips from 3.86 h (0.909, 623 failed); best 0.917 (416 failed) at 8.9 h, fewest failed 345 at 9.8 h; no decline in 10 h. Paper: 0.94 and 25 failed at 3 H100-h (~8 A6000-h)

claim: From 1 to 264 h of motion, 8-step WM error stays 0.007-0.011 and GPU-hours to target grow slowly
ours: 1 h: benchmark 0.88 at 1.41 h, best 0.962; 7 h: benchmark 0.88 at 1.97 h, best 0.925; 40 h: benchmark 0.88 at 1.44 h, best 0.915; 261 h: benchmark 0.88 at 2.06 h, best 0.914 (A6000-hours, each library scored on its own clips; paper 0.54 -> 1.89 H100-h; our WM error is not on the paper's nominal scale)

3.04 A6000-h to pass SONIC's return in our simulator vs ~21,000 L40-h: 6,919x; 3.86 A6000-h to beat it on both return and failed clips (with our action-noise fix): 5,440x (SONIC scored in our simulator: 0.893, 642 failed; paper's own: 0.90, 179)
142,220 -> 129,115 -> 128,904 (261.29 h); the name filter's exact keyword list is not given in the paper

claim: RL-trained velocity encoder beats distillation on 650 of 672 step responses
ours: RL lower error on 652 of 672, distillation on 20; median relative error 0.042 vs 0.222 (paper 0.16 vs 0.49); distillation fell on all trials of 0 commands (paper 7); trained on LAFAN1 walk/run/sprint only
